svg.text: version 3.2: 15 Application/Technology cells that differ from 3.1, and every cell that involves Business, Motivation, Strategy, Physical, Implementation, composite or junction types, use provisional values not yet verified against the 3.2 specification text. line 6: realization from Device "Rack Server" to Node "Web Node" is not allowed in ArchiMate 3.2. Allowed: flow, association, triggering, serving. (provisional 3.2 rule, not yet verified against the 3.2 specification)
